name: set_reminder
description: Manage reminders that pop an on-screen notification with sound at a specific time. Use for 'remind me at 3pm to check the print' or 'remind me in 20 minutes to stretch'. Reminders persist across app restarts. Provide EITHER in_minutes OR time (24-hour HH:MM, optional date).

parameters.description: add = create a reminder. cancel = remove one by text match. list = report pending reminders.
What to remind the user about, e.g. 'check the print'. Required for add; used to match for cancel.
Fire the reminder this many minutes from now. Use for relative requests like 'in 20 minutes'.
24-hour time HH:MM (e.g. '15:00' for 3pm). Use for absolute requests like 'at 3pm'.
Optional ISO date YYYY-MM-DD for the time parameter. Defaults to today (or tomorrow if the time already passed).
